newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - General Mills estimates up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - General Mills estimates up.

text.p: -- BT Securities analyst John O'Neil raised his estimates on General Mills Inc to $3.14 a share from $3.05 for fiscal 1997 and to $3.50 a share from $3.40 for fiscal 1998.
-- He retains a market perform rating on the stock.

-- On Thursday, the cereal and food company reported stronger than expected earnings for the fiscal second quarter of $1.00 a share, up from $0.92 a year ago and above the First Call consensus of $0.95.

-- "Although these trends are solid for General Mills, the stock is now trading at 20 times 1997 earnings, and there are still questions within the category as to what Kellogg (Co) may be planning for next year, which creates additional uncertainty," O'Neil said.
-- Cereal giant Kellogg, which has lost market share recently, has indicated it will launch a marketing program soon, but has given no specifics.
-- General Mills stock closed Thursday up 2-3/8 at 65-5/8.
